headline.title: Anthropic proposes $70–78 IPO plus conditional $26 billion strategic placement
headline.summary: Anthropic’s November 10 amended filing proposes 825 million publicly offered shares at $70–78, including about 23.65 million sold by existing holders. The company receives no proceeds from those secondary shares. Seven strategic partners separately agreed to a $26 billion non-voting share placement, conditional on the IPO closing and other requirements. Google’s $10 billion contribution draws on its earlier commitment; it is not another $10 billion of newly promised funding. At the assumed $74 midpoint, Anthropic estimates approximately $84.6 billion of combined net proceeds to the company, or $93.7 billion if the underwriters fully exercise their additional-share option. Those estimates include the placement and must not have $26 billion added again. The proposed capital would support general corporate purposes, including compute and infrastructure, rather than an exclusive hardware budget. These are proposed transactions, not completed fundraising or cash already available.

sources.title: Anthropic November 10 S-1/A amendment 2, cover and Use of Proceeds

headline.impact_reason: The proposed financing could materially expand a frontier lab’s ability to fund compute. Completion, net proceeds, secondary sales and reused commitments determine how much new cash actually reaches it.
headline.confidence: High for filed terms and conditional agreements; final pricing, completion and proceeds remain uncertain.
headline.event_date_scope: November 10 preliminary filing; editorial review November 11. No completed IPO or trading debut is asserted.
